messages:
Sarah Chen: quick sync — Acme asked for a committed plan. They expect ~75k DAU, ~2–3 messages/user/day, but main ask is 99th pct chat latency <350ms at peak. They want committed reserved GPU pricing + autoscale behavior. @James @Rui can you sketch a runway and rough $ impact?
James Patel: got it. need the traffic shape: avg vs peak, message length distribution, and model variant. assuming avg 40 tokens per message and peak qps ~400 (30x above avg) we should model for 500peak rps headroom.
Rui Gomez: short take from infra — for a 500peak rps profile on an LLM with ~40 tokens/request, rough capacity options:
- Option A (latency-first): 6x A100-80GB reserved, autoscale floor 2, burst pool +2 spotable GPUs, target util 65–70%. expected 99p <350ms with our optimized kernels + continuous batching.
- Option B (cost-first): 4x A100 reserved, autoscale floor 1, aggressive quantized model variant (int8) for lower perf but 30–40% cheaper. 99p will be ~450ms unless we increase batch parallelism.
I can run perf sims if you confirm model + seq length.
Lena Brooks: pricing note — committed monthly rate for reserved capacity (example numbers for discussion only): 6x reserved = ~$60k/mo committed (discounted vs on-demand), 4x reserved = ~$42k/mo. If they want strict SLA + dedicated capacity add enterprise premium (~+$6k/mo). For hosted metered we can offer blended rates with volume tiers (we can show token-based vs reserved math in the deck).
Ana Martinez: security and onboarding check — Acme will need VPC peering, KMS integration for keys, and 365d audit-log retention. They flagged SOC2 Type II + yearly pen test evidence. Also ask for a runbook for failover to a fallback model (lower-cost variant) if we hit capacity caps.
Sarah Chen: good. @Rui can you confirm KV-cache warmup time and cold-start queue behavior? they care about ramp minutes when hitting bursts.
Rui Gomez: KV-cache warmup: based on their profile we should plan a 5–15 minute warm window for 90% warm cache coverage if they start a big burst. autoscale/cold-start notes:
- queue depth allowed: 200 max for short bursts (we can extend with burst credits)
- scale cooldown: 120s default, reduce to 60s for this customer during PoC if they accept slightly higher risk of oscillation
- prewarm policy: start an extra instance at 60% predicted traffic 10m before expected peak (we can schedule preheat for known windows).
James Patel: for POC next week can SRE share a small load test harness? something we can run from perf-lab to validate 99p and cost numbers. a simple curl loop + token reporter is fine.
Rui Gomez: will drop a minimal script in the thread. quick smoke (replace $TOKEN):
```
for i in {1..1000}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rw-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":64}' &
  sleep 0.01
done
```
This pushes concurrent traffic; we'll run against the staging reserved pool. include `--limit-rate` or ramp if needed.
Lena Brooks: POC pricing — we can offer a 2-week trial on 4x reserved at 50% list for smoke-tests, then convert to negotiated commit. I'll queue a short quote and T&Cs.
Ana Martinez: I'll prep a one-page security summary (VPC, KMS, SOC2 evidence, network flow logs) and a short onboarding checklist for their infra team.
capacity-bot: Reminder: reserve-pool-config change requires 48h lead time to guarantee capacity in region. Submit change request at infra-ops.
Sarah Chen: plan: 1) James/Rui run perf sim + drop results into this thread by EOD tomorrow, 2) Lena to send trial quote, 3) Ana to send security summary, 4) I'll update the presales deck and sync with Acme on Wed. any blockers?
James Patel: sgtm, dropping perf sim artifacts soon.
Ana Martinez: no blockers from CS side.
Lena Brooks: no blockers from pricing.
Rui Gomez: will try to reduce warm window by testing larger batch windows; may need model variant confirmation.
Sarah Chen: thanks all :thumbsup: I'll capture the numbers and follow up with the renewal/commit worksheet after perf results are in.
